So you know how to select possible passwords when hacking terminals in Fallout 3. Asides from the words you chose as passwords, there are several code snippets hidden that look just like random text. They must start and end with a < >, ( ), { } or [ ]. there can be letters in between eg (2.fh y5tsd) would work, basically it doesn't matter what letters are between the ( and the ) as long as it opens and closes with a ( ), [ ], { } or < > . When selected these not so obvious selections will remove a dud password or reset your available guesses.
